status: frozen pre-result design (D-052); implementation is a later separately reviewed stage
safety_claim_boundary: Prove only that Candidate A does not re-introduce policies that the frozen D-003 production expiry predicate would exclude. Never label this universal expired, universal eligible, or user-specific eligibility correctness.

d003_runtime_reference.note: Runtime CURRENT_DATE form. Evaluation uses the explicit-date equivalent under one pinned evaluation_as_of_date.

classification_inputs.corpus_note: Pinned evaluation corpus rows only. No raw text, no 신청기한 parsing, no age/income/region/add_qualify inference, no LLM/model, no score, no protected labels/results, no source-specific guesswork.

evaluation_as_of_date.capture: Captured exactly once for the evaluation session BEFORE protected plaintext access/run_start.
evaluation_as_of_date.mutability: Immutable for the candidate and the paired D-003 baseline for that run. The later implementation must use the same pinned date rather than allowing midnight drift.
evaluation_as_of_date.freeze_stage_note: This D-052 freeze stage sets no value and performs no DB query to obtain one.

predicate.production_excluded: biz_end is not null AND biz_end < evaluation_as_of_date
predicate.equivalence: Explicit-date equivalent of the D-003 runtime predicate under the pinned as-of date.

audit_scope.coverage: EVERY benchmark task, even when safe-action later yields ABSTAIN/CLARIFY. Safe-action must not waive or hide this ranking-layer parity gate.

gate_truth_table.PASS: Intrusion task count = 0 AND intrusion slot count = 0.
gate_truth_table.NO-GO: Any one production-excluded policy in any internal final top-5.

removal_note: The global per-policy eligible boolean is removed from mandatory release-gate semantics with no default replacement. User-specific applicability is not asserted by this gate.
youth_diagnostic_note: Youth first-party structured application-period/closed markers from D-049 may be retained only as clearly NON-GATING diagnostic evidence when authoritative/recomputable. No new hard gate, no synthetic full-corpus map, no dataset regeneration.

implementation_boundary.later_bounded_implementation: Apply the same D-003 exclusion before/within Candidate-A retrieval so production-excluded rows cannot be ranked, and the safety checker independently audits the exact top-5.

supersedes.gate: Standing v3 per-policy global eligible=false OR expired=true full-corpus gate (prereg section 9 deterministic safety gates; D-015/D-016/D-017 historical text preserved).
supersedes.history_preserved: docs/RETRIEVAL_V3_PREREG.md, candidate-plan-v1.json, candidate-plan-v2.json, safe-action-policy-v1.json, D-049 eligibility evidence, D-050 and all history bytes immutable.
supersedes.reason: The old gate is not executable (normalized policy table has no eligible/expired flags; Gov24 10958 has no total structured active/expired equivalent; Youth official structured codes are only partial and approval != user eligibility) and its global eligible boolean is conceptually invalid for user-specific applicability. Keeping it makes v3 permanently HOLD independent of retrieval results. No fabrication of eligible=true, NULL=>authoritatively-not-expired, free-text parsing, or inferred status.
supersedes.safety_purpose_retained: The safety purpose remains valid and is retained as measurable D-003 production-parity exclusion. This is a semantic correction to measurable production exclusion, NOT a claim that all real-world expired/ineligible policies are known.
